speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The loaf is still a thumb short of the notch, and it is still a penny.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I asked you yesterday if it was the lovers. You said no. I am not asking what is in the shut book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then there is nothing to tell. Not today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Eat. I am not your counting-house on a Sunday, and I have not asked you to open anything.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not open the coffer. I will not open it today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Tuesday is the quarter. Today you eat what is on the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Today I eat. That is the whole of the news.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then let it be the whole. The dish is down.
